artworks.title: Ni por esas (Neither Do These)
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in a dramatic confrontation. The central figure appears to be engaging with others around them, conveying urgency and struggle. The use of stark contrasts and dark shading enhances the tense atmosphere. A building silhouette is visible to the left, emphasizing the interaction. This painting is in the style of Francisco Goya.

artworks.title: Y no hai remedio (And There's No Help for It)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure bound to a wooden pole, wearing a blindfold with arms tied behind. There are lifeless bodies on the ground, and a line of soldiers with rifles in the background. The scene is in the style of Francisco Goya.

artworks.title: No se convienen (They Do Not Agree)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic battle scene with soldiers engaged in combat. Several soldiers are depicted on foot and horseback, with one rider on horseback raising an arm. Figures are engaged in close combat, wielding swords and other weaponry. The background is filled with smoke or clouds, enhancing the sense of chaos and movement within the scene. The composition is in black and white, with strong contrasts and intricate line work detailing the figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Yo lo vi (I Saw It)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting several figures engaged in a dramatic interaction. The foreground shows two figures in motion, with others in the background contributing to the chaotic scene. In the background, a hilly landscape is visible with a mound that could represent a distant fort or castle. The figures appear to be involved in a narrative conveying urgency or tumult. The scene is designed in a monochromatic palette, typical of etchings, emphasizing light and shadow to convey emotion and depth.

artworks.title: Y esto tambien (And This Too)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint or lavis, drypoint, and burin
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures walking together carrying large bundles. The figures are moving from right to left, huddled closely together. They appear to be struggling under the weight they are carrying, as large bundles are slung over their shoulders. The figures are depicted in intricate details, with texture and movement in their garments. The background is a mix of dark and light shading, with a gloomy, textured sky. The drawing conveys a mood of hardship and perseverance.

artworks.title: Tanto y mas (Even Worse)
artworks.description: This is a painting of multiple figures lying on the ground in different poses. Their clothing is depicted in dark tones against a light background of an overcast sky and a simple structure in the distance. The scene suggests a moment of aftermath, with figures and objects like swords lying still. The work likely conveys themes of tragedy and conflict. This is done in the style of Francisco Goya.

artworks.title: No se puede mirar (One Can't Look)
artworks.medium: etching, burnished lavis, drypoint, and burin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in distress. The scene shows figures in different poses of anguish and despair, depicted in a sketch-like style with strong contrasts between light and shadow. The dark background emphasizes the spotlighting effect on the central figures, creating a dramatic atmosphere. Sharp and ominous surrounding objects hint at a possible threat or danger.

artworks.title: Modo de volar (A Way of Flying)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts various human figures in flight. The main figure is at the center with large, bat-like wings. Surrounding them are several other figures with different styles of wings or flight apparatuses. The background is dark, and the figures stand out against it. The detailed textural lines give a sense of exploration of human flight.

artworks.title: Nada (Nothing)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and lavis with burnishing (proof) on laid paper

artworks.title: Si quebro el cantaro (Yes He Broke the Pot)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a broken jug, with shards scattered on the ground. A figure appears frustrated, grasping another. In the background, laundry hangs on lines. The scene is depicted in monochrome with emphasis on facial expressions and body language.

artworks.title: Tal para qual (Two of a Kind)
artworks.medium: etching retouched with stumped black chalk on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. In the center, a woman stands with a man holding her hands. The woman has dark, curly hair and is wearing a long, detailed gown. The man wears historical European clothing and holds a fan. Behind them, another person in a hooded garment can be seen partially. The background is plain with grey tones, suggesting an outdoor setting. The image is framed by a border on aged paper.

artworks.title: Margarita de Austria
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on heavy laid paper [first edition impression printed in the Calcografia in 1778-79]
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated side-saddle on a horse. She holds the reins, has an oval face with slightly upward eyes, dark styled hair with ornaments, and wears an ornate gown. The background features a lightly sketched outdoor environment.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait at the Easel
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper [cancellation proof]
artworks.description: The image displays a grid of intersecting dark lines creating squares across the entire surface. Within this grid, there is a sketch of a profile view of a person in a contemplative position. The linear strokes suggest details of the face, hand, and clothing, evoking a sense of historical or artistic figure engaged in drawing or writing. The grid overlay intersects the lines, blending abstraction with familiarity.

artworks.title: Thames Fishermen
artworks.medium: drypoint with etching in dark brown on chine colle
artworks.description: There is an image of a waterway flanked by trees and shrubs, leading to a broader vista with a horizon lined by trees and distant landforms. The sky has swirling clouds, and the brushstrokes are detailed, showing light, shadow, water reflections, and vegetation texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and sepia, resembling an etching. The calm water reflects the scene, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Amalfi
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow alleyway surrounded by old stone buildings. The viewpoint is from inside the alley, looking through a series of archways creating a tunnel effect. The scene features intricate architectural details and textures depicted in an etching style with fine lines and hatch marks. The color scheme is monochromatic, using sepia tones and black for contrast. In the distance, there is hanging laundry and sparse vegetation on the buildings.

artworks.title: Breaking Up of the Agamemnon
artworks.description: The image shows several boats anchored along a waterfront. An aged ship with intricate rigging is in the background. A cityscape with domes and masts is visible on the horizon. The sky is intricately detailed with swirling lines. The color palette is in sepia tones, giving a historic feel to the scene.

artworks.title: Breaking Up of the Agamemnon
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with ships in a harbor. The vantage point is elevated, looking over the ships with tall masts and a distant skyline. The etching technique uses detailed lines to depict the ships and water. The scene is monochromatic with a vintage feel. Small boats are close to the viewer, while a larger ship with rigging and sails is at the center. More ships are seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Breaking Up of the Agamemnon
artworks.description: The image displays a maritime scene with a ship in the foreground on the right side. Additional smaller vessels are seen in the distance on the left, leading up to a city skyline. The horizon line is low, near the base of the buildings and ships on the skyline. The sky has dynamic cloud patterns with swirling lines. The color palette is primarily sepia tones.

artworks.title: Breaking Up of the Agamemnon
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a shipyard viewed from a low vantage point near the waterline. The harbor is depicted as busy and bustling. In the background, there are various city buildings, including a dome. A large ship with detailed rigging and an aged wooden hull is prominently featured on the right. The etching technique is evident through fine lines creating a textured sky. The color scheme is mainly black and sepia, typical of etchings. The scene includes other ships and a quay, providing depth and guiding the viewer's gaze through the image.

artworks.title: Breaking Up of the Agamemnon (The Second Plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a busy river scene with various boats and elements of a shipyard. The viewpoint is slightly elevated close to the water, facing the cityscape in the background. The etching technique emphasizes intricate lines, creating depth and complexity. The color palette is earthy with sepia and dark brown tones. Small boats are seen in the foreground, with a large ship to the right and more boats and buildings in the distance.

artworks.title: A Lancashire River
artworks.description: The image shows a river landscape with cows, some of them standing in the water. Tall trees line the riverbank in the background, under a sky with clouds. The sketch is detailed with fine lines and sepia tones, creating a warm atmosphere.

artworks.title: Thames Fishermen
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, trees, and the sky. In the foreground, a boat with two figures is on the river. The sky has subtle cloud formations, and the horizon is low, allowing for a wide view. The details are depicted with fine lines to show texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and the natural color of the paper. The sides of the image are darker due to clustered trees.

artworks.title: Thames Fishermen
artworks.description: The image shows a riverscape with two figures standing beside a moored boat on the riverbank. In the background, a gently rolling landscape with trees can be seen. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting the foliage and water surface. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and sepia. Trees on both sides of the river frame the scene.

artworks.title: The Test at Longparish
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint in dark brown
artworks.description: The image shows a waterway surrounded by shrubbery and trees. The horizon is in the center with foliage blending into the sky. In the distance, a bridge or structure is partially visible. The artwork features expressive brushstrokes and detailed textures in a monochrome color palette dominated by earthy sepia tones, presenting a tranquil view of light and shadow along the river.
